breaking.change: 3D bodies now enable gyroscopic torque by default; spinning asymmetric bodies can follow different trajectories.
breaking.fix: Set gyroscopic: false explicitly if the game wants rotation without gyroscopic torque, and retune spinning bodies.

breaking.change: Physics now precedes og.camera and og.ui.end/sound/audio. Camera collision and world-anchored UI read this tick's simulated transforms rather than the previous tick's.
breaking.fix: Remove compensating one-tick camera/UI offsets and order systems against the new post-physics presentation boundary.

breaking.change: All scene queries use the live Rapier world, including ragdoll bones and 2D wheels. Before og.physics they see tick-start colliders; after it they see the new step. Between ticks they see the last simulation state, not unsynchronized ECS edits. The boundary system initializes once, without rebuilding a shadow BVH each tick.
breaking.fix: Run gameplay queries before og.physics for tick-start visibility; run post-step queries after it. Expect newly spawned or moved ECS colliders only after physics synchronizes them. Exclude the caster to apply ContactHook.ignore and compound self-exclusion.

breaking.change: Engine save migrations, automatic engine/session layout mapping and RestoreDesc.migrate are removed. Saves use og-save:4 with the exact engine version, strict saved layouts and physics state format 2; old formats and other engine versions are refused, never upgraded.
breaking.fix: Start new saves on engine/layout changes; remove migrate from RestoreDesc. Register collider assets before restoring a current-format save. Explicit SaveEdit edits of game-owned data remain available within the current engine version.

breaking.change: Compound mass/centerOfMass no longer double-count collider mass; sensors contribute no mass. Parented bodies and static colliders now use full world transforms, including mirrored mesh winding and negative scale.
breaking.fix: Remove mass/COM and parent-transform workarounds, then retune bodies that depended on the previous incorrect inertia or collider placement.

breaking.change: Changing damping, gravity scale, locks, CCD or other nonstructural body/collider parameters patches the live objects rather than rebuilding them and losing contact warm starts or joints. Kinematic motion retains pose-derived velocity.
breaking.fix: Do not rely on parameter edits to reset simulation; explicitly reset the intended pose/velocity. Keep body kind, mass/COM and shape/topology changes separate when a rebuild is intended.

breaking.change: Queued forces, torques, air drag, buoyancy and force-field effects now act through the substep loop instead of only the first substep. Buoyancy samples the evolving body pose.
breaking.fix: Remove substep-count multipliers from forces and retune drag/buoyancy against their physical units.

breaking.change: Solid impacts that begin and end inside one tick's substeps now emit CollisionStarted and CollisionEnded even when no contact survives the final substep. Contact impulses accumulate across substeps.
breaking.fix: Handle a Started/Ended pair in the same event batch and avoid assuming every impact appears in the final og.Contact list.

breaking.change: Hooks apply symmetrically to both sides and inherit from a compound's body. Two friction/restitution overrides are averaged; conveyor surface velocities combine as their relative motion. Each one-way side keeps independent contact state. Hook changes wake affected contacts.
breaking.fix: Remove handle-order-dependent hook workarounds and specify each surface's own velocity/one-way direction rather than the pair's combined result.

breaking.change: Nonstructural joint edits preserve warm starts and hinge reference angles; breakForce/breakTorque use solver load over substeps rather than an extra gravity-load approximation.
breaking.fix: Remove joint-recreation/angle-offset compensation and retune break thresholds to the solver's force and torque.

breaking.change: Settled bodies lose residual velocity without rolling their simulated pose back. Sleeping connected islands are traversed coherently and wake on relevant gravity, body, collider and hook changes.
breaking.fix: Do not depend on restSpeed freezing a previous pose or on parameter edits leaving bodies asleep; use explicit locks or constraints for fixed poses.

breaking.change: Water, Wind, WindMotor, ForceField and Volume inputs synchronize immediately before physics, after gameplay and scene/stream updates, rather than in an early before-tick hook. Terrain restore edits replay before initial physics queries.
breaking.fix: Remove one-tick environment buffering and apply environment edits in gameplay systems for this tick's step.

breaking.change: Ray, point-projection and shape-cast reaches must be finite and nonnegative; zero remains unbounded. Compound self-exclusion uses the body identity and heightfield chunk hits are deduplicated.
breaking.fix: Pass 0 for unbounded reach instead of Infinity, reject negative/NaN distances in game input, and stop manually filtering duplicate chunk hits.

added.summary: Dominance groups control one-way mass influence in contact resolution.
Enable or disable a body without replacing its component.
Control 3D gyroscopic torque explicitly.
Request extra iterations on an island containing this body.
3D cone colliders and query shapes.
Open or segmented mesh polylines in both physics profiles.
2D heightfield profiles in addition to 3D height grids.
Rounded boxes, cylinders, cones, convex hulls, diamonds and hexagons.
CombineRule average/min/multiply/max friction selection.
CombineRule average/min/multiply/max restitution selection.
Separate solver force-resolution membership bits; zero inherits collision layers.
Separate solver force-resolution mask bits; zero inherits the collision mask.
Enable or disable collision detection and scene-query participation.
Generic six-degree-of-freedom joints with Joint.lockAxes.
JointMotorModel selects mass-independent acceleration or force/torque motor interpretation.
Ball joints support swing/twist limits.
Filter dynamic, fixed and kinematic bodies with QUERY_DYNAMIC, QUERY_FIXED and QUERY_KINEMATIC; zero includes every kind.
RaycastDesc and RaycastAllDesc choose immediate inside hits (default true) or exit-surface hits.
ShapeCastAllDesc returns capped, sorted swept-shape hits with collider and body identities; ShapeCastHit.body also identifies compound owners.
PointOverlapDesc returns every collider containing a point.
Read the live solver's computed mass, world center of mass and principal inertia.
Read a live body's linear plus angular velocity at a world-space point.

fixed.summary: Rendered bones interpolate between tick snapshots using position lerp and short-arc quaternion slerp.
World-origin rebases shift root-space hang points and anchors along with physics and ragdoll targets.
Physics hierarchy lookup checks entity generations, ignores null parents, rejects invalid transforms and handles ancestor cycles safely.
Lazy collider geometry resolves on the engine thread before lane-pool synchronization; 2D outlines handle signed zero, duplicate triangles, pinch vertices and collinear chains consistently.
Asset-backed collider shapes are stripped in one serialization pass with checked hole offsets, retaining generated geometry and immediate restored query/hook state.
